annotations.title: Extract text from a PDF URL

description: Extract text from a PDF by URL: the text of each page of a public PDF file (up to 10 MB), with the page count, title and author; scanned PDFs without a text layer fail uncharged. Use to read reports, papers, invoices and filings into an LLM, RAG or an agent's context. Example: url=https://bitcoin.org/bitcoin.pdf. Price $0.005/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of text returned across all pages (1000-200000, default 50000)

pages.description: How many pages to read (1-200, default 20)

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the PDF

name: pdf_extract
title: Extract text from a PDF URL
